subject: reasoning
question:
Select the dice(s) that can be formed by folding the given sheet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18c372c4493782ac224bb02bf801a165afc3030d3207bcf945832538b5f8e049.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7436c16be6487eff863e2bd9e495bca4f57d1c194cab7ddb5430017ba3fef7c1.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:-

The opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below method:-

__
 
• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
 
• No two opposite surfaces are touched by side or by corners

So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.

In the given figure, Opposite faces are :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57891005db4ada293a0c837027c2d2b44092cbc201cc3cf89d2cd59fc538a26a.png] 

1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd72a6672b6926a42d6c13119aa72e78e419c36598ed2f3530287e9d25abbc.png] → **All are adjacent sides of given cube.**

2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f818e3cbd12f0b310368d557b4b127e28fb6765c20d26465ea63bd1d91e799d.png] → Here on top it should have X face instead of K face.

3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/415df9079447b595eee73a1936750478dbb9cfb25e8c7fafc487e01c4e0ef211.png] →All are adjacent sides of given cube.

4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e441f23bfd160f00461e94df29ba19652dc5650c878517e6e6cab9ae1ccd776.png] → Here K and X are opposite faces but given as adjacent sides.

∴ Here, dice A and C are formed after folding the sheet.

Hence, the correct answer is **"A and C".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

For Figure A, the unfolded dice can be represented as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b98b8f9b8c4c0c5bcd52a075bc67c5e249a90974135225afdf69b0cdd3a4a09.png] 

From above, the sequence is the same, thus dice shown in Figure A can be formed.

For figure C

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9725f5225ec85930b4f538e0f2bb28665788f94bb2a75948162762d0d6baf9a.png] 

From above, the sequence is the same, thus dice shown in Figure C can be formed.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] __Mistake Points__**Option 2 can't form a Dice.

As, while folding the cube **X should be the upper face of H and L**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28f2d715726a93029084557cabceb60037e4a2e26ee1dc35c1348d9425150ee1.png] 

And, **K should be the bottom face of H and **L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/007e15f7f880a993f99b34413bf518448279f6e3a384b68ff5407724901e2db2.png] 

K is placed below H in the given DIce, so K can't be above H.
